notes.title: Weekly Update 6/9/2025
notes.content:
[p]Sorry that this update is late, we're in a different week now. Nice weather has been causing distractions.  
  
So here's a look at Suncatcher in action. Suncatcher will be a tanky Corvette that is fairly slow but highly resistant to beam weapons.  [/p][p][/p][p]The Fronde have been the most technically difficult race to develop. Their artwork is organic, their movement mechanics are not straightforward, and I'm covering them with Unreal's foliage system - which wasn't really designed to move around. Oh yeah, and the tentacles were a pain. It's been fun!

notes.title: Weekly Update: May 2, 2025
notes.content:
Thanks everyone for helping in the first week of Early Access. Many bugs were found and squashed, and I'm sure there are many more!  
  
Right now I am working on ships for the Fronde race. They are living creatures and move in a different way than the other ships. I also have more bosses being polished up and another mission to add.    
  
In July I hope to release 3 Fronde ships, at least one new boss, and a new mission. If I have time I will also get out a new ship or two for the existing races.  
  
Keep bring me bugs! It's very helpful to get feedback.    
  
And if you don't understand something, feel free to ask me either here or on Discord.

[list]

[*]Too many Raptorlings	
If you kill the egg, it will now launch at most half of the Raptorlings of a full egg. Something something omelettes.

[*]Eye of Chaos was firing continuously in certain cases.	
Stopped him from firing continuously

[*]Cursor resetting to default after clicking buttons 	
I fixed this in a couple cases, this is ongoing and I'm hunting for a universal fix that isn't hacky.

[/list]

Fixed a bug preventing missions from ending.
Fixed a bug that sometimes caused boss music to persist after the boss died.

notes.title: Early Access Release!!
notes.content:
This is the initial Early Access release for GALACTIC WARSHIP. It's a very crude version of the game and I hope you'll see the potential and help me improve.  
  
My plans are: Better interface, more mission-focused gameplay, more ships, more bosses, more cool stuff, more polish.  There's a complete roadmap available here and I'll provide regular updates.
  
Thanks to anyone who has helped so far.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419899/c0ee7bde3cd613f8759b8161ccd53fbbd83df8c8.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo Update 04/20/2025
notes.content:
Based on feedback from NextFest, I've added some features to the demo as I prepare to go into Early Access:  
  
Direct Targeting -  You can now select and enemy directly. Your weapons will attempt to target that enemy if they are able.  

Enemy Info - Information on a given enemy now displays when you hover your cursor over it.  
  
Objective and Enemy Indicators -  Icons will appear at the edge of your screen to tell you where important objects or enemies are in relation to your viewpoint.  Objectives now have a HUD icon that will follow them for easier identification.

notes.title: GALACTIC WARSHIP RoadMap!!!
notes.content:
[b]The GALACTIC WARSHIP Roadmap!!! [/b] 
 
I'm excited to finally share this with everyone- Galactic Warship is hitting Early Access this April 2025!
This Early Access release will just be the start of something bigger. The game is definitely playable and packed with cool stuff, but I've got so many more ideas and features planned. I want you all along for the ride as we make this game even more awesome.

[b]What's in the Early Access release?[/b]

The Early Access version will have plenty of features and allow me to gather feedback on what people like and what they don’t. You get to play with 9 different ships from 3 totally different alien races (The final game will have 6 races.)

•	Humans: Classic no frills “Human race in a game where nothing else is normal” warfare - solid armor, hard-hitting guns, and getting better with experience

•	Velox: Space-raptors who LOVE explosions. These guys are fast and everything goes boom

•	Caligo: These sneaky aquatic aliens are all about "you can't hit what you can't see" and fancy beam weapons

You'll get to take these ships into three wild realms (Chaos, The Dark Forest, and the Celestial Abyss), fight some seriously tough bosses, and unlock tons of cool stuff along the way. There is an interactive library system that tracks everything you've found and tells you more about the story. Early Access will have some basic Steam Achievements as well, and rudimentary gamepad support. 

[b]What's Coming Next?[/b]  
  
I’ve planned four major updates to the game before the Final Release. Each update will focus on introducing a new race, as well as additional bosses, missions, and other features.

[b]July 2025 - The Fronde Update[/b]

Ever wanted to pilot a living spaceship? That's exactly what you're getting! The Fronde are communal organisms that love to explore, spread joy, and eat new things. They're all about adapting and healing during fights. 

[b]October 2025 - The Apparatus Update[/b]

The Ronin Apparatus are AI that have detached themselves from a central command and operate independently. These super defensive ships that are all about controlling the battlefield and ignoring classical physics.

[b]April 2026 - The Occultum Update[/b]

The Occultum  - High Risk, High Reward. The Occultum sacrifice themselves for their beliefs, and are granted ultimate power in return. Their ships are glass cannons with immense potential in the right hands.

[b]April 2026 - The Big One[/b]

This is when everything comes together - every race will have 9 ships to choose from. There will be (at least) 15 boss fights to tackle, and tons of achievements to hunt down. 

[b]Let's Build This Together![/b]

I want your feedback. I’m going Early Access because I need your help shaping GALACTIC WARSHIP into the best game it can be. See something you think could be better? Let me know! Have an idea for a cool feature? I’ll steal it!

I'll be regularly updating the game, fixing things that need fixing, and adding new stuff for you to play with. Think of it as us teaming up to make something awesome.
Ready to jump in? The void is calling, and there's a whole lot of space out there to explore!

notes.title: GALACTIC WARSHIP Demo Release and Roadmap
notes.content:
I’m excited to finally release a demo for GALACTIC WARSHIP and share my plans for the game. Your feedback and patience are going to be critical to shaping and improving this into the best game it can be!  
  
The Roadmap:
Demo (Today):
•	Three Playable Races – Human, Caligo, Velox
•	Three Ships
•	One Realm
•	One Mission
•	One Boss
•	Limited Controller Support

Release 1: Early Access (April 1, 2025)
•	Nine more Ships 
•	3 Realms with at least one Boss for each Realm
•	More Missions
•	Permanent Progression
•	Upgrade and Story Libraries for each active Race
•	Steam Achievements
•	Better Controller Support

Release 2: Fronde (July 1, 2025)
•	Fronde Race
•	More Ships 
•	More Bosses
Release 3: Occultum (October 1, 2025)
•	Occultum Race
•	More Ships 
•	More Missions
•	More Bosses

Release 4: Apparatus Race (Jan 1, 2026)
•	Apparatus Race
•	More Ships 
•	More Bosses

Final Release: Apparatus Race (April 1, 2026)
•	Fronde Race
•	More Ships 
•	More Missions
•	More Bosses

I’ll provide more details as we approach each release. You can also check Steam Discussions for more info.
